caption: The drawing depicts a carved and painted statue of a man with gray hair and a beard, dressed in a light blue suit coat with yellow buttons, a light cream shirt, a pink bowtie, one light yellow pant leg and one brown pant leg, and black shoes. The man is shown in a forward-leaning pose with his right knee raised and bent, standing with his right foot on a decorative base that features ornate gold and brown scrollwork on a gray block. His left arm hangs naturally, while his right hand is raised and positioned near his chest. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Figurehead
